subject: CYCLE-2 DESIGN/SUPERSESSION: host-tiered Flex Deck + exact DeckToken
body: Cycle2 supersedes the Cycle1 half-screen-overlay idea. Revised host policy: prefer PUBLIC split/adjacent hosting only when runtime getSystemActions exposes GLOBAL_ACTION_TOGGLE_SPLIT_SCREEN and a Fold7 probe proves the foreground app docks/restores correctly; otherwise use a COMPACT nonfocusable accessibility overlay so an arbitrary full-screen app is not falsely treated as reflowed. Control capability is separate: BASE Duo-owned/public controls; GESTURE explicit canPerformGestures opt-in; SEMANTIC explicit window-content/node-action opt-in; PRIVILEGED Shizuku/shell research-only and never auto-selected. Exact DeckToken = (serviceEpoch, postureSequence, displayId, foregroundRevision, capabilityTier, hostMode), invalidated on reversal/exit, privacy/unknown, native Flex conflict, restart, display remap, app revision, or capability downgrade. Prototype remains field-gated.
